name: finish_after_second_close
description: Recording A closes at 60 s and its transcript lands at 70 s; recording B closes two minutes later, at 180 s. Finish is tapped at 185 s with nothing in progress, before B's transcript lands. Finish must finish B (the newest recording), not A's still-open window.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 with the SCA-4434 fix (302 reads, 73 writes, 1 delete(s), 12 no-op, 1 STT, 6 LLM; caps about +10%). The rise over the pre-fix 231 reads / 0 STT is B's fast-finish pass and its reconciles, which the fix exists to start, plus at most 8 reads for the Finish recent-source scan. noop_writes=12 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.
